'''Angry giant rats''' are [[monster]]s that appear during and after [[A Soul's Bane]] in [[Tolna's rift]]. The rat near the entrance is the only monster in Tolna's rift that drops an item when killed.

During the quest, they can only be killed with the [[anger maul]]. Angry giant rats can be fought with any weapon after the quest. Angry giant rats do count toward a [[Rats (Slayer assignment)|Rats slayer assignment]].
